readme:
# DESIGN:OS Bridge

**A plugin and a CLI so your coding agent can read and edit the Figma file you have open.** DESIGN:OS Bridge runs in Figma Desktop, including on the Free plan. The `figma-agent` CLI talks to the plugin over a local WebSocket on `127.0.0.1` (ports 9410 to 9419). One undo step per mutation. No seat, no access token, no model inside the bridge. You bring your own agent: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any shell. The repository is [`jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin`](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin). The product name is DESIGN:OS Bridge. FREE + source-available ([PolyForm Shield 1.0.0](LICENSE)).

Quickstart · Use with your agent · FAQ · How it works · Install · Limits

## Quickstart ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin.git cd design-os-figma-plugin npm ci && npm run build # Node.js 22; builds cli/dist/figma-agent.js and plugin/code.js node cli/dist/figma-agent.js status --peek ``` Then, in Figma Desktop: **Plugins → Development → Import plugin from manifest…** and pick `plugin/manifest.json`. Open the plugin in a scratch file first. **In Claude Code**, you can also install the plugin from the marketplace: ```text /plugin marketplace add jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin /plugin install design-os-figma-plugin@design-os-figma-plugin ``` Check the connection from the repository root: ```bash node "$PWD/cli/dist/figma-agent.js" status --wait --timeout 60 ``` ## The rail The plugin shows a compact status rail in the file you have open. This is a real capture of that rail, not a mock.

Idle, Connected, and the work in flight. The orb, the sentence, and a caret to expand. ## Use with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex The bridge has two parts: a **plugin** that runs inside Figma Desktop, and the **`figma-agent` CLI** that your agent runs in a shell. The CLI talks to the plugin over a local WebSocket on `127.0.0.1` (ports 9410 to 9419). No model runs inside the bridge. **Set up once (any agent)** ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin.git cd design-os-figma-plugin npm ci && npm run build ``` In Figma Desktop: **Plugins → Development → Import plugin from manifest…**, then choose `plugin/manifest.json`. ```bash node "$PWD/cli/dist/figma-agent.js" status --wait --timeout 60 ``` **Claude Code** ```text /plugin marketplace add jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin /plugin install design-os-figma-plugin@design-os-figma-plugin ``` Or write the skill from your built CLI: `node cli/dist/figma-agent.js install-skill --folder ~/.claude/skills --with-craft --yes`. **Cursor** Cursor loads skills from `~/.cursor/skills/` and `~/.agents/skills/` ([Cursor docs](https://cursor.com/docs/skills)). ```bash node cli/dist/figma-agent.js install-skill --folder ~/.cursor/skills --with-craft --yes ``` Then ask in Agent chat: "Inspect my current selection with the design-os-figma-agent skill." **Codex** Codex scans `~/.agents/skills/` for user skills ([Codex skills docs](https://developers.openai.com/codex/skills)). ```bash node cli/dist/figma-agent.js install-skill --folder ~/.agents/skills --with-craft --yes ``` Without a skills folder, tell any shell agent to run `node "$PWD/cli/dist/figma-agent.js" status` and then read its command list. ## FAQ **Does it replace the official MCP server?** No. They coexist. The official server is the better tool for Code Connect, cross-library search and working with Figma Desktop closed. This bridge reads and writes the open file through the Public Plugin API. **Does it need a paid seat?** No seat or access token for the bridge. It needs edit access to the file for writes, and Figma Desktop running the imported plugin. **Is it on the Community listing?** No. It is a development plugin imported from this repository. **Does it run or pay for a model?** No. You choose and pay for your own agent or provider. **Can the agent undo its own work?** Yes. Each typed mutation seals its own undo step, so one undo rolls back one change. **What licence is it under?** It is source-available under [PolyForm Shield 1.0.0](LICENSE). The [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) file governs. ## How it works

The CLI exposes **42 commands**, from the catalog in `cli/src/command-catalog.ts`. A short sample: | Command | What it does | | :--- | :--- | | `status` | Broker and plugin connection. `--peek` never spawns a broker. `--wait` can. | | `inspect` · `context` · `get-selection` | Read the current selection or a node, compacted for an agent's context window. | | `scan-design-system` | Scan tokens and components in the open file. | | `create-frame` · `set-text` · `bind-variable` · `set-autolayout` | Typed writes. Each one seals its own undo step. | | `export-png --assert` | A PNG snapshot, checked, before or after a mutation. | | `install-skill` · `install-hook` | Install the agent skill or a hook into a project. | Every command prints one JSON object to stdout and exits 0, or `{error:{code,message}}` and exits 1. The full list is in [`docs/operations.md`](docs/operations.md) and in `figma-agent --help`. The official write MCP is plan-gated. This bridge is a local alternative for the file you already have open, and it coexists with that server. See [the official rate limits](https://developers.figma.com/docs/figma-mcp-server/rate-limits-access/) for what the official server requires. Nothing in the bridge sends data off your machine. See [`PRIVACY.md`](PRIVACY.md). ## Install Choose the setup that matches your agent. The canonical skill is [`skills/design-os-figma-craft/SKILL.md`](skills/design-os-figma-craft/SKILL.md). After a build, `install-skill` writes it for you. The copies below are for a manual install. ### Claude Code ```text /plugin marketplace add jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin /plugin install design-os-figma-plugin@design-os-figma-plugin ``` ### OpenAI Codex ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin.git /tmp/design-os-figma-plugin mkdir -p ~/.codex/skills/design-os-figma-craft ~/.codex/prompts cp -R /tmp/design-os-figma-plugin/skills/design-os-figma-craft/* ~/.codex/skills/design-os-figma-craft/ cp /tmp/design-os-figma-plugin/prompts/doctor.md ~/.codex/prompts/design-os-figma-craft-doctor.md rm -rf /tmp/design-os-figma-plugin ``` ### Gemini CLI and Google Antigravity ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin.git /tmp/design-os-figma-plugin mkdir -p ~/.gemini/skills/design-os-figma-craft cp -R /tmp/design-os-figma-plugin/skills/design-os-figma-craft/* ~/.gemini/skills/design-os-figma-craft/ rm -rf /tmp/design-os-figma-plugin ``` ### OpenCode, Cursor, Windsurf and other agent harnesses ```bash git clone https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin.git /tmp/design-os-figma-plugin mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills/design-os-figma-craft cp -R /tmp/design-os-figma-plugin/skills/design-os-figma-craft/* ~/.agents/skills/design-os-figma-craft/ rm -rf /tmp/design-os-figma-plugin ```
Verify or uninstall **Verify:** ```bash node cli/dist/figma-agent.js status --peek python3 scripts/self_check.py ``` Or run `/doctor` inside Claude Code or Codex. **Uninstall the skill copies:** ```bash rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/design-os-figma-craft ~/.codex/skills/design-os-figma-craft ~/.gemini/skills/design-os-figma-craft ~/.cursor/skills/design-os-figma-craft ~/.agents/skills/design-os-figma-craft ```
## Limits - The plugin has to be open in Figma Desktop, with the file you want to edit already open. It cannot talk to a file that is only in the cloud. - It does not replace Code Connect, cross-library search, or work that needs the official Figma MCP server with Figma Desktop closed. - It is not listed in the Community catalog. You import `plugin/manifest.json` from this repository. - Converting an arbitrary live HTML page through a third-party scraper is out of scope. Use image fills or the typed frame builders, including the `html-to-figma` command in this CLI when that is the right tool. - `html-to-figma` extraction runs inside an opaque iframe with `sandbox="allow-scripts"` (loading only the pinned CDN domains declared in `plugin/manifest.json`). Repository JavaScript can update its own DOM and styles, cannot access the panel document, and only a validated result from the active child with matching protocol and request identity is accepted; this browser boundary does not enforce a separate CPU or process budget. ## Watch DESIGN:OS Bridge is FREE + source-available (PolyForm Shield). One episode of the Autonomous Design Agent series from the [design:os by Jang](https://www.youtube.com/@designosbyjang) channel (Vietnamese, with English terms):

Watch [Autonomous Design Agent Ep. 5: Two-way bridge: One Comment, the AI Fixes Design and Code](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c6yc314JsTI) (2:44) for how one review comment can drive changes to both the design file and the code through DESIGN:OS Bridge. More episodes: [Autonomous Design Agent playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAgHz-2MRSJw). ## DESIGN:OS This is one of the DESIGN:OS tools.
